g.title: ER
g.text: OpenMeet storage - conceptual ER, meeting ownership (Chen notation)

g.title: cluster_standalone
g.text: Not meeting data: kept by delete_all_meeting_data and retention

g.title: legend
g.text: Each "owns" diamond is one declared FOREIGN KEY
meeting_id REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE (11 in total):
deleting a meeting deletes every row it owns.
Double line = total participation (meeting_id is NOT NULL).
Weak entities (double rectangle, identifying double diamond):
participants and topics have PRIMARY KEY (meeting_id, position);
meeting_summaries has PRIMARY KEY meeting_id, so at most one per meeting.
The settings row used by the store is name = 'app' (JSON settings document).
